## Review attestation
- Verdict: SHIP
- Reviewed-Commit: c79e491e4615652565a111a2325df7fa52d4525f
- Reviewer: fresh-context subagent (Step 2), 2 passes (pass 2 on c79e491; rebased onto main, patches unchanged)
- Findings:
  - Handoff tests discriminate (no-op process_approval_response fails); stub mode deterministic, no LLM → ok
  - [pass 1 nit] 4 DB-only dashboard tests took an unused facade fixture → removed; PR states only 2 exercise the facade; get_agent_metrics_from_db uncovered
  - Deletions match the #65 triage → ok
  - Checkpointer DB in data/ (tracked dir, *.db ignored); test DB sqlite; no HAPI writes → ok
  - Both files deterministic under CI unit filter (run twice) → ok
  - requires_api_key test not run (billed) → accepted

## Review attestation

Reviewed commit: `02fc979afe7b03de714f21a354d81ab6878aab2b`
Verdict: **SHIP** (fresh-context review of 02fc979; earlier commits attested previously)

- Root cause confirmed from code: `_ensure_initialized` sets `checkpointer_factory` to the process-wide `get_checkpointer` singleton, which nothing closes; its non-daemon aiosqlite thread kept CI pytest alive after all tests passed (run 41773588089, hung ~2.5h).
- Fix: per-test `AsyncSqliteSaver` on tmp_path injected after init; facades closed before the saver. Assertions unchanged.
- Evidence: local CI-equivalent full suite now exits on its own (was timeout exit 124 with a lingering aiosqlite thread traced to `test_agent_handoffs.py`); file passes 3/3.
- Findings: none behavior-changing. Note (pre-existing): `test_real_agent_executions_are_tracked` passes with an empty key locally; marker only deselects in CI.
